title: Add multi-region availability metrics + SLO-friendly aggregations
author: Allison Grant
release_notes:
- Adds standardized multi-region availability metrics for Hosted API and Dedicated routing outcomes
- Adds recording rules to produce low-cardinality SLO inputs (burn-rate friendly)
- Documents recommended dashboard panels + query patterns in code comments
description:
Context
This PR adds multi-region availability metrics and SLO-friendly aggregations needed for the Regional Failover Automation Upgrade (ENG-2411) and Multi-region Availability SLO 2026 workstream.

Problem
We currently have good per-region availability/error metrics, but we lack:
- A canonical definition of “multi-region availability” for services behind smart routing (Hosted API + Dedicated)
- Low-cardinality, burn-rate friendly time series suitable for SLO evaluation and alerting
- Consistent dimensions to explain *why* multi-region availability was lost (routing policy, reachability, capacity gating, control plane)

What’s in this PR
- New emitted counters/histograms in the routing/gateway path to capture multi-region outcomes:
  - routed request outcome (served locally vs served via failover vs dropped/overload)
  - effective region (where the request was ultimately served)
  - requested region (original target)
- New recording rules producing SLO inputs at fixed label sets:
  - `redwood:multiregion:requests_total` (by product, tier, route_class)
  - `redwood:multiregion:errors_total` (5xx + selected gateway/timeout categories)
  - `redwood:multiregion:availability_ratio` (precomputed ratio for dashboards; SLOs should use numerator/denominator recording rules)
- Guardrails to keep label cardinality bounded:
  - route is grouped into `route_class` (chat|embeddings|rerank|other) rather than raw path
  - tenant_id is not included; we rely on tier + product (hosted|dedicated)
  - model is intentionally excluded from SLO series; model-level views remain available in separate non-SLO dashboards
- Inline guidance (comments) adjacent to the rules for dashboard authors:
  - which rules are safe for alerting
  - expected query windows for 1h/6h burn-rate alerts
  - common pitfalls (mixing effective vs requested region)

Not in this PR
- Burn-rate alert rules (landed separately in PR-19818)
- Dedicated drain progress metrics (separate PR)
- Any changes to failover decisioning logic (policy engine/controller PRs)

How to validate
- Deployed to staging: `staging-us-east` and `staging-eu-west`.
- Confirm recording rules evaluate cleanly (no "many-to-many" joins; no missing series) and remain low-cardinality.
- Smoke queries included below.

Smoke queries
- Multi-region denominator:
  sum(rate(redwood:multiregion:requests_total[5m])) by (product,tier,route_class)
- Multi-region numerator:
  sum(rate(redwood:multiregion:requests_total[5m])) by (product,tier,route_class)
  - sum(rate(redwood:multiregion:errors_total[5m])) by (product,tier,route_class)
- Breakdown served via failover:
  sum(rate(redwood_multiregion_routing_outcome_total{outcome="served_failover"}[5m])) by (product,tier,route_class,from_region,to_region)

Rollout plan
- Stage 1: ship metrics emission behind `obs.multiregion_slo_metrics_enabled` (default off)
- Stage 2: enable in staging + internal canary tenants
- Stage 3: enable in production for Hosted (tier=free + tier=pro), then Dedicated

Risk notes
- Primary risk is metric cardinality growth; this PR includes explicit aggregation + label restrictions and a small unit test to prevent adding disallowed labels to SLO series.
- Secondary risk is semantic mismatch with SLO definition; reviewers from SRE/SLO dashboards signed off on the numerator/denominator choices.

Checklist
- [x] Metrics emitted and documented
- [x] Recording rules added with stable label sets
- [x] Added unit test to prevent accidental high-cardinality labels in SLO series
- [x] Staging validation
- [x] Linked to ENG-2418

Refs
- ENG-2418 Add failover metrics and SLO burn alerts
- Regional Failover Automation Upgrade (ENG-2411)
- ADR-042 Failover trigger signal hierarchy (related; not required for this PR)

metrics: add multiregion request/error recording rules
tests: add label-set regression test for SLO series
docs(comments): add dashboard query guidance + pitfalls
chore: wire feature flag default off + staging enablement note
review_conversation: Aisha Bello requested a clearer separation between SLO inputs (low-cardinality, stable) and exploratory breakdowns; author updated naming to use `redwood:multiregion:*` for recording rules and left the detailed breakdown on raw emitted metrics only. Sergio Costa flagged that `requested_region` vs `effective_region` was easy to misuse in dashboards; author added an explicit comment block with examples and renamed one label from `region` -> `effective_region` for clarity. Miles Thornton asked how overload/drop is treated; author clarified in description and code comments that overload responses count against availability for the multi-region SLO (consistent with customer impact), and included a breakdown metric to distinguish 5xx vs overload/timeouts. Ravi Menon noted a potential cardinality spike from `from_region,to_region` combinations; author limited those labels to the raw outcome counter and kept the SLO recording rules aggregated by product/tier/route_class only. Final approvals after staging validation screenshots were posted in the PR thread.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash merge into main; feature flag remains OFF by default pending PR-19818 alert tuning and game day readiness.
